# CANDIDATE: ORB_VIX_FADE_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

An expanded opening range (OR) accompanied by rising VIX often signals exhaustion in the first 30 minutes, leading to a mean-reversion back toward the OR midpoint. This edge exists because high volatility and wide OR indicate overextension, and the market frequently reverts intraday as initial momentum fades, particularly when VIX confirms rising fear.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Enter short at the close of the 30-minute OR bar when:  
- (OR high - OR low) > 2 × the 5-day average ATR (expanded OR)  
- Current VIX > its 5-period EMA (rising VIX)  
- Bar closes below the OR midpoint (bias toward fade)  

**Exit:**  
- Chart-stop at OR high (primary invalidation)  
- TP1 at 1 × OR width below entry (initial profit target)  
- Runner: Trail 20% off the high-water mark for remaining position (lets winners extend)  
- Time stop at 15:50 ET (0DTE constraint)
